wish: someone should make an app that charts your walking miles on a map of Frodo's journey
spec:
Charts walking miles along a drawn 1,800-mile route with nine named stops.
Type miles walked and tap add; the marker moves and the next stop shows.
It does not sync, import step counts, or use a real map.
notes: Title uses a generic phrase in place of the character name; route is abstract with plain place labels.
